hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Jumping from index i moves to index i + k repeatedly until exceeding the array boundary.

hints.title: Subproblem Structure
hints.text: The total energy gained starting at index i equals energy[i] plus the total energy starting at index i + k.

hints.title: Right-to-Left Traversal
hints.text: Iterate backwards from n - 1 down to 0, updating dp[i] = energy[i] + (dp[i + k] if i + k < n else 0). Return the maximum value in dp.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: In-place backward pass over energy array.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all jump chains independently takes O(n^2 / k) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space by updating energy array in-place.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Traverse backwards to compute cumulative path energy in linear time.
